For many people, dressing up in a way that makes them feel put-together and polished can give them a boost of confidence and self-assurance. It's also worth noting that confidence is not just about how others perceive us, but also about how we perceive ourselves. When we feel good in what we're wearing, it can translate to other areas of our lives, such as our interactions with others, our body language, and even our overall attitude. Secondly, even if you did have a live turkey, it's not a reasonable or humane solution to take it out of the fridge as a reward for having a bad day. It's better to find other ways to cope with stress and tedious days, such as taking a break, practicing self-care, or engaging in a relaxing activity.
